claims.quote: Weight loss reduces lean muscle mass, potentially impacting resting energy expenditure and/or physical functioning.
reductions from baseline in total fat mass (-19.3%)
Although total lean body mass decreased from baseline (-9.7%)
it increased by 3 points relative to total body mass
Total fat mass, total lean body mass and regional visceral fat mass were measured using dual-energy absorptiometry (DEXA)

message: Some lean mass goes along with weight loss, so measure what is changing instead of trusting the scale alone.
reasoning: Muscle loss is a top-three worry in the brief. We do not deny it and we do not scare: fat fell about twice as much as lean mass, and the scan is how you can tell. That sets up Steer's DEXA-first approach without promoting any drug.
